title: Live culture or streaming at home
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le és hasonlítsd össze a képeket, fejtsd ki a véleményedet a megadott szempontok alapján, majd beszélgess a vizsgáztatóval az élő kulturális élményekről és a streamingszolgáltatások hatásáról.

scenes.description: In an elegant old theatre with red velvet seats and golden balconies, the audience is giving a standing ovation at the end of a play. The actors are bowing on the stage, holding hands. In the front row, a teenage girl is clapping enthusiastically next to her grandmother, who is wiping a tear from her eye. Everyone is dressed up for the evening.

A teenage boy is lying in bed late at night, watching a series on his phone, with the light of the screen on his face. A message on the screen says 'Next episode starts in 5 seconds'. There is a bag of crisps beside him, and his school bag is lying on the floor, still unopened. The clock on the bedside table shows 1:30 a.m.

prompts: Compare the two ways of enjoying a story and the experiences of the people.
Is live entertainment still important in the age of streaming? Why?
How do streaming services influence our habits, for example our sleep and attention?
followUpQuestions: Why do you think fewer young people go to the theatre than in the past?
Have you ever binge-watched a series? How did you feel afterwards?
Should theatre and concert tickets be cheaper for students? Who should pay for that?
Can a film or a series be as valuable as a book or a play? Why?
